development_evidence: One inspected Codex project had both root entries, with the Claude entry duplicating substantially more guidance while declaring the Codex entry canonical.
One inspected Codex project had only AGENTS.md and one shared docs/nulnul state, which is the desired first-host shape.

The shipped contract names the detected-host entry but also says AGENTS.md remains canonical when both hosts are present; deterministic tests cover AGENTS.md migration but not reciprocal host ownership.

pathology.why: root session-entry ownership is ambiguous when Codex and Claude Code are used sequentially in one repository

hypothesis: A deterministic active-host session-entry writer, backed by reciprocal preservation checks and one shared docs/nulnul state, will let Codex and Claude Code alternate in one repository without either host creating, rewriting, or becoming canonical over the other host's root entry.

evaluation_roles.development: The two inspected user projects and the existing host/migration contract.
evaluation_roles.validation: Fresh temporary Codex-only, Claude-only, and both sequential-order repositories generated after candidate implementation.
evaluation_roles.holdout: One fresh temporary mixed-host repository shape created only after the candidate source hash is frozen, then retired after one run.

negative_controls: existing user guidance outside the managed entry is preserved
simultaneous multi-host mutation is not claimed or implemented
promotion_gate: the inactive host entry remains byte-identical
both root entries point to the same single shared state when both hosts are present
full repository tests and Release Gate pass
one post-freeze mixed-host live cycle passes without rollback
rollback_threshold: Roll back after one active-host run changes the inactive host entry, creates a second live-state writer, loses existing host guidance, accepts an unsupported host or ambiguous shared state, or expands permissions.
falsification_condition: Any required sequence or negative control fails, another root entry is changed, shared state is duplicated, existing guidance is lost, the helper needs a dependency or global registration, or a post-freeze mixed-host cycle fails.
claim_boundary: This episode may establish sequential Codex and Claude Code root-entry ownership over one repository-local shared NULNUL state. It does not establish concurrent multi-host editing, cross-host conflict merging, universal host support, or repository-receipt promotion.
